text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
One, two, one, two.
...Here, my leg goes――

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hya!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Auuugh, another failure...
I need to practice more...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fwah!? Onii-sama!?
I-I've been spotted—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fwah!? Onee-sama!?
I-I've been spotted—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. Um...
I wanted to practice while nobody was around.
choice_data_list: Why are you all by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...The other day during our class lesson,
the studio had a, um... blackout."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I ended up interrupting everyone's lesson...
It's probably... because Rice was there...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't want to cause trouble for everyone again...
That's why... I was practicing alone."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...If you stay here too, Big Brother,
it might cause trouble for people...
choice_data_list: Would it trouble you if I'm around?
Would I just be a bother if I'm here?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "...If Big Sis stays here right now, Rice might cause trouble for you too..."
choice_data_list: Would it trouble you if I'm around?
Would I just be a bother if I'm here?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not true!
Big Brother would never cause trouble for me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not true!
Big Sister would never cause trouble for me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice wants Onii-sama to point out
the parts of the dance Rice isn't doing well...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice wants Onee-sama to point out
the parts of the dance Rice isn't doing well...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

Afterward, Rice Shower and I were able to
thoroughly practice the parts of the dance
she struggled with.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fweh!? N-No way!
I don't want to cause trouble for Big Brother...!
choice_data_list: It'd be worse if Rice just sat there worrying all alone.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fweh!? N-No way!
I don't want to cause trouble for Big Sister...!
choice_data_list: It'd be worse if Rice just sat there worrying all alone.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is it okay if I... ask for some advice about practice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-Thanks!
Actually, there's a tricky part in the footwork—

Afterward, I stayed up late discussing
and advising Rice Shower on her dance practice.
